settings.title: Channels
settings.intro: Talk to an agent from Telegram, Discord, Slack or WhatsApp. Each chat on the app becomes its own PasaBot chat.

add.title: Add a channel
add.label: Name (optional)
add.labelHint: Shown only here, e.g. “Family group bot”.
add.tokenHint: Paste it once. It is kept in the vault and never shown again.
add.allowedHint: Platform user ids, one per line or comma-separated. Leave empty so only you can talk to it.
add.noKinds: No channel apps are installed on this server.
add.pairingNext: After adding it, you link it by scanning a QR code with your phone.

binding.ownerNone: Not linked yet: only linked or allowed senders get answers.
binding.placesNone: No chats yet. Message the bot to start one.
binding.removeConfirm: Remove this channel? The bot stops answering; its chats stay in PasaBot.

link.how: Send this to the bot in a direct message within 10 minutes:
link.warn: Only in a direct message. A code posted in a group is cancelled.
link.ownNumber: Own number: send the code in your own “Message yourself” chat.

ownNumber.label: Which number
ownNumber.off: A separate number for the agent
ownNumber.on: My own number (I talk to it in “Message yourself”)

events.title: Events URL
events.how: Paste this into your {{app}} app’s event settings. Every request is checked against the signing secret.

pairing.title: Link {{app}}
pairing.riskTitle: Before you link: this is not an official connection.
pairing.riskBody: PasaBot joins your {{app}} account as a linked device, the same way a computer does. {{app}} does not allow automated use of personal accounts in its terms of service, so it may limit or ban the number.
pairing.riskAdvice: Use a number you can afford to lose, and keep the number of messages low.
pairing.accept: I understand the risk, show the QR code
pairing.scan: On your phone, open {{app}} → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this code. It changes every few seconds.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to link this device
pairing.failed: Linking did not finish ({{reason}}). Try again.

add.title: Add a chat app
add.tokenHint: Paste it once. It is kept safe on this computer and never shown again.
add.allowedHint: Each person's number or user name in that app, one per line. Leave it empty so only you can talk to it.

field.signingSecret: Second secret code from the app

binding.tokenNew: New secret code from the app
